items.headline: PGA Tour Playoff Delay
items.text: Players including Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler face challenges preparing for a playoff scheduled with additional holes on a non-play day, creating an unusual playing situation.

items.headline: DeChambeau Ends PGA Tour
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau shot 76 in the opening round of the 2022 Memorial Tournament, marking a difficult end to his PGA Tour career before his move to LIV Golf.
